---
title: "Final Model Evaluation"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Load Everything

```{r}
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)

source("../R/07_diagnostics.R")

load("../data/processed/test_data.rda")
final_model <- readRDS("../models/final_model.rds")
```

# Evaluate Model

```{r}
eval_result <- evaluate_model(final_model, test_data)
```

# Diagnostic Plots

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
plot_diagnostics(eval_result)
```

# Statistical Tests

```{r}
residual_tests(eval_result)
```

# Error Analysis

```{r}
error_analysis(eval_result)
```

# Summary

Model performance on test set:
- RMSE: `r round(eval_result$rmse, 2)` points
- R²: `r round(eval_result$r2, 3)` (explains `r round(eval_result$r2*100, 1)`% of variance)
- Within ±10 points: `r round(mean(abs(eval_result$residuals) <= 10) * 100, 1)`%
